item.title: New Chillicothe Police Officer
item.description: The Chillicothe Police Department will have a new police officer on Tuesday. Police Chief Jon Maples says the City Council approved Anthony Baucom. Comes with some experience and was a former Chillicothe Dispatcher Maples says the department is still down a couple of officers from full strength.
